title: Sequoia · ultrasound — quick win, no gates

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: Amara, you mentioned pain under the right ribs after fatty meals?

utterances.speaker: patient
utterances.text: Yes, sharp and short, maybe twenty minutes each time. It wakes me up some nights.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: Classic story for gallstones. Any fevers, yellowing of the eyes, or weight loss?

utterances.speaker: patient
utterances.text: No, none. Just the pain episodes.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: Which insurer are you with these days?

utterances.speaker: patient
utterances.text: Sequoia Mutual, same as last year.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: Then this is straightforward: let's get an ultrasound of the abdomen ordered to look at that gallbladder.
